notes: All 361 pieces from the parts list are present, and each type/colour count matches the list (checked line by line).

The booklet's grey-on-black line drawings are hard to read for the base. The base geometry, the exact rests_on of many base pieces, and which side studs a given tile or plate attaches to are best-effort inferences.
Pieces added from underneath are listed with forward references: a later id can be underneath an earlier id, so an earlier piece's rests_on may include a later id.
Pieces attached sideways to side studs (Sydney tile plates, 1x8 and 1x4 side tiles, pylon tiles) have rests_on [] and appear in other_joins.
Deck: 10 LBG jumper plates form the top. They carry 4 black clip tiles (ends), 2 black 3L bars, 4 black 4L bars and the arch handle plates. The arch is 4 tile segments hinged by handle-in-clip joins.
Tower floors: white clip plates carry the vertical and diagonal bars. The mapping of which bar goes in which clips is inferred from the pictures.

Sydney Tower: the red axle, two axle connectors, two blue axle pins, pin connectors and yellow bars form the shaft. Two 3942c cones, one 6233 cone and 6 dishes sit on it. The tip is a white 6L bar through a gold dish, a gold wheel and a second gold dish.
Opera House: six hinge sails (6134 on 3937). Which sail goes on which hinge base is inferred.
